title: fix(lint)!: refuse a stored sort on a `sortable: false` field, on list views and every stored page sort
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBGAgbDVW8xmM2xwwkx5q3JU)_

Fixes #30023

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`validate-sortable-fields` 不再自己判断「虚拟类型」，改为读数据接口列表门所用的同一个可排序投影 `resolveObjectSortability`，所以字段写了 `sortable: false` 时，列表视图的 `sort` 报 `sort-field-unsortable`（error）；同时把规则扩展到页面上所有会打到列表门的已存排序（区块自身 `sort`、元素 `dataSource.sort`、相关列表 `parentDataSource.sort`、列表页 `interfaceConfig.sort`、应用页 `record.sort`），并让 page 写入门也跑这条规则。
- 为什么改：#30021 之后列表门对这种排序答 400 `INVALID_SORT`，但 `os validate` 和发布门照样放行，于是视图首次加载起每次都 400；页面上的排序此前完全不判可排序性（公式字段也一样）。
- 风险与回滚：接受集收窄（BREAKING，Metadata-protocol narrowed，`@objectstack/lint` 和 `@objectstack/spec` minor）：带这种排序的视图或页面在下次 validate / 保存时被拒（422），已存的照常加载。仓内语料没有任何 `sortable: false`，示例栈实测 0 条新发现。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts` 的 `unsortableFinding`、`validatePageSorts`、`PAGE_BLOCK_SORT_OBJECT_PROP`；`reference-integrity-suite.ts` 的 `page` 跨入。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol exec vitest run src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts -t 30023`（先建 lint），预期 7 个用例全过：视图和 4 个页面槽位被拒在各自路径，对照（无键、`true`、公式字段保留自己的判定）照常。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `sort-field-unsortable` (error) now also fires on a sort naming a field whose author declared `sortable: false`, on the list-view rungs it already walked and on every stored page sort it did not walk before (a block's own `sort`, every element `dataSource.sort`, a related list's `parentDataSource.sort`, a list page's `interfaceConfig.sort`, an app page's `record.sort`, where a `formula` sort is now refused too), so `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` and the `page` and `view` publish doors refuse metadata they used to accept. The widening half: `@objectstack/lint` exports `indexObjectSortability` and the `SortabilityFields` type, and `checkSortDeclaration` takes an optional trailing `sortability` index.
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` names no `sortable` field key and no page or view `sort` rule; `content/docs/**` already teaches `sortable: false` as "do not allow sorting by this field". The prescription ships in the finding's fix line, `os explain sort-field-unsortable` and the upgrade-guide entry.

## What changes

- **One projection, two reasons** (`packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.ts`). The virtuality check no longer calls `isVirtualSearchField` itself. It reads the projection `resolveObjectSortability` (`@objectstack/spec/api`) builds from the authored object, the resolver the list door (`assertSortFieldsExist`) refuses by. A `sortable: false` entry with `reason: 'virtual-type'` keeps the existing message byte for byte. One with `reason: 'author-declared'` reports `sort-field-unsortable` at `error` with the door's clause: `list-view sort orders by "body", a field on object "help_ticket" that declares `sortable: false`, so every load answers 400 INVALID_SORT`. The fix line is `Sort by another field, or remove `sortable: false` from "body" to make it sortable`. Only the literal `false` counts. A formula field that also declares `sortable: false` keeps its virtual verdict, because the projection does.
- **Grading.** `error`, the level the #9257 precedent (`formula`) publishes at. The door answers both reasons with the same `400 INVALID_SORT` on the view's first fetch.
- **The exported core stays compatible.** `checkSortDeclaration` takes an optional trailing `sortability` index (`indexObjectSortability`, exported). If a caller omits it, the projection comes from the type-only slice, so the caller gets the pre-change answers (virtual only). This is the posture the `unprovisionedAnchors` parameter already has. Every in-repo caller passes it.
- **Every stored page sort is walked** (`validatePageSorts`), for the projection's verdict only:
  - each component's `dataSource.sort`, bound to `dataSource.object`;
  - a `record:related_list`'s `properties.parentDataSource.sort`, bound to its own `object`;
  - the `properties.sort` of each block that declares one, bound to `dataSource.object` and then the block's object prop. The `PAGE_BLOCK_SORT_OBJECT_PROP` table is pinned against `ComponentPropsMap`:

    | Block | Object prop |
    | --- | --- |
    | `list-view` | `data.object` |
    | `record:related_list` | `objectName` |
    | `record:line_items` | `childObject` |
    | `object-grid`, `object-calendar`, `object-gantt`, `object-map`, `object-timeline` | `objectName` |

  - a list page's `interfaceConfig.sort`, bound to `source` and then the page `object`;
  - an app page's `record.sort`, bound to `record.object`.

  `validate-page-field-bindings` still owns existence and provenance on these positions, as `page-field-unknown` / `page-field-unprovisioned`. This rule adds only the question that rule does not ask, so no name is reported twice.
- **The page door** (`reference-integrity-suite.ts`, `authoring-rules.ts`). `validateSortableFields` declares `page`, and the suite entry's `runtimeTypes` gains `page`. A page write reaches exactly this one member: no other member declares `page`. The member resolves only against `stack.objects`, which the per-write page snapshot carries. That is the #9313 reason, one write type over. The page dispatch pin (`runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts`) lists `validateReferenceIntegrity`.
- **`os explain sort-field-unsortable`** (`rule-explanations.ts`) gains the author-declared paragraph and the page surfaces.
- **Upgrade-guide entry** `18.field-sortable-false-sort-refused`: `surface` and `acceptanceCriteria` now list every stored surface above (delta review 6625831334 ③). The `reason` sentence "Lint does not yet judge a view `sort`…" is replaced. It now says that `os validate` and the publish door refuse each surface.
- **Changeset:** `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/spec` are both `minor`, with `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, the BREAKING banner, and Before / Now / Not changed / The remedy. The ADR-0087 marker is `not-required (already-registered field-sortable-false-sort-refused)`, which cites the existing entry. A **Supersedes, in the same release** paragraph corrects #29896's unreleased note "Lint does not yet judge these at authoring." Before writing it I checked that npm `@objectstack/spec@18.3.0` (published 2026-11-03 15:15Z) does not carry `field-sortable-false-sort-refused`.

## Why

#30021 (`140d8ce8`) makes the list door refuse a sort that names a `sortable: false` field. The lint rule keyed only on `isVirtualSearchField`, so `os validate` and the view door both passed such a view. On a page, none of the stored sorts was judged for sortability at all. The rule walked only the five list-view rungs, and its module note left page sorts to `walkPageComponents`' territory, where only existence was asked. The view then broke on every load, traced to nothing.

## Readings

- **Surfaces before this PR:**
  - The rule walked `objects[].listViews.*.sort`, `views[].list.sort`, `views[].listViews.*.sort`, the flattened overlay `views[].sort` and the record `views[].config.sort`, all for the virtual verdict only.
  - It walked no page surface.
  - The suite did not dispatch on `page` writes. `runtimeAuthoringRulesFor('page')` listed no `validateReferenceIntegrity`.
- **Surfaces the delta review missed, found by enumerating every `sort:` key under `packages/spec/src/**/*.zod.ts` and by the new drift pin:**
  - `record:line_items` `sort`;
  - the page `list-view` node's own `sort` (`ListViewPageProps` spreads `ListViewSchema`);
  - the related list's `parentDataSource.sort`.

  The drift pin first went red naming `list-view`, which the hand list had missed.
- **App page `record.sort` reaches the door.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/PageView.tsx#appPageRecordBinding` mounts it through `ElementDataSourceGate` with `sort: true` (objectui#12931). Its `liveness/page.json` row still says `planned`, which is stale. That is noted below and not changed here.
- **Corpus.** No shipped object declares `sortable: false`: `grep -rn "sortable: false"` over `examples/`, `packages/platform-objects/src` and `packages/plugins` finds nothing. `validateSortableFields` over `examples/app-crm` (6 objects, 1 page), `app-todo` and `app-multi-package` gives 0 findings. `examples/app-showcase` (24 objects, 29 pages): 0 findings. Non-vacuity probe: with every authored field set to `sortable: false` in memory, the same run fires 3 findings, 2 of them on pages (`pages[14].interfaceConfig.sort[0]`, `pages[17].interfaceConfig.sort[0]`), so the page walk reaches the shipped corpus.

## Tests

- `packages/lint/src/validate-sortable-fields.test.ts` (+16):
  - **The author-declared verdict:** exact message and fix, path, and `error` level. It fires on the legacy string form, on `-field`, and on the overlay and record view shapes.
  - **Controls:** no key, `true`, and a formula field with `sortable: false`, which keeps the virtual message.
  - **Projection identity:** the rule's index deep-equals `resolveObjectSortability(object).fields`.
  - **The exported core's optional parameter:** absent, it answers only the virtual verdict; present, it answers both.
  - **Every page slot is refused at its path:** related list `sort`, its `dataSource.sort` and `parentDataSource.sort`, `object-grid`, `record:line_items`, `list-view`, an element `dataSource.sort`, `interfaceConfig.sort` and `record.sort`.
  - **Binding precedence:** `dataSource.object` wins over the block prop. A list page with no `source` binds to the page `object`.
  - **A formula sort on a page is refused.**
  - **Page controls:** no key, `true`, an unknown name, a dotted path, `created_at`, another package's object and a block with no `sort` prop are all not reported. Neither is a `kind: 'react'` page's cached regions.
  - **`PAGE_BLOCK_SORT_OBJECT_PROP` ↔ `ComponentPropsMap`:** every row with a live `sort` key, each with a live object prop. The tombstone detector is pinned non-vacuous on `element:record_picker.sort`.
- **The real publish route** (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`, a new `describe` on the existing stub-engine harness, so no double ledger moves; +7):
  - `PUT` view with `sort: body` gives 422 `INVALID_METADATA` with `sort-field-unsortable` at `views[0].sort[0]`, carrying the door's clause, and stores nothing.
  - A page sorting by `body` at a `record:related_list` `sort`, an element `dataSource.sort`, a list page's `interfaceConfig.sort` and an app page's `record.sort` gives 422 at `pages[0]…` slot paths, and stores nothing.
  - Controls: `subject` (no key) and `priority` (`sortable: true`) save on the view and on all four page slots. `score` (formula) is refused with its own virtual message on the view and on a page.

## Verification

Readings are at `90989939` on base `c23501b2`, unless marked otherwise. Head `c745679c` adds only the `index.ts` export of `indexObjectSortability` / `SortabilityFields` and the matching changeset clause. For that head:
- lint `tsc`, `check:test-typecheck` and the four touched lint test files (90 tests, including `rule-id-barrel-exports`) were rerun.
- `check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:published-files`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:api-surface`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check-adr-0087-registration` were rerun, all exit 0.
- The `--commands` derivation is unchanged: the same 82.

- **Builds.** A full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --concurrency=2` ran under the verify lock: 119 tasks, 0 failed, 11m16s on a shared box.
- **Package suites.**
  - `@objectstack/lint` `test`: 193 files, 7988 tests passed. `typecheck`: 0.
  - `@objectstack/spec` `test`: 811 files, 24387 tests passed. `typecheck`: 0.
  - `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `test`: 312 files, 22354 tests passed, 26 skipped. `typecheck`: 0.
  - `pnpm lint` (repo eslint): 0.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 82, and all 82 ran with exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran` reports 82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; the record is `/mnt/project-files/issue-30023/gates-ran.list`.
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 because this shallow clone could not reach its pinned fixture. After `git fetch --unshallow origin main` it exited 0, and 48 cases passed.
  - `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: `not-required (already-registered)` accepted.
  - `check-changeset-no-major` with this body as the event: LEVEL AXIS `yes (narrowing)` + `narrowed`, and no moved package is graded `patch`.
- `test:repo` was not run locally. It belongs to CI (Test Core).
- **Ablation A**, at the author-declared verdict. I changed `unsortableFinding`'s guard to also return for `reason === 'author-declared'`, rebuilt lint and reran both files:
  - `validate-sortable-fields.test.ts`: `Tests 7 failed | 57 passed (64)`. The 7 are the author-declared and page-slot cases. Every control, and the formula page case, stayed green.
  - The route pins: `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed`. The view and the 4 page slots went red; the 2 controls stayed green.
  - Restored: the blob equals HEAD.
- **Ablation B**, at the page-door crossing. I dropped `'page'` from `validateSortableFields`' member `runtimeTypes`:
  - The lint unit file stayed green: `64 passed`.
  - The route pins went red, `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed`: the 4 page slots and the virtual page control. The view refusal and the save control stayed green.
  - Restored: the blob equals HEAD.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not walked, by design:** a `kind: 'react'` page's JSX props (`validate-react-page-props`' territory, unchanged), dashboard widget `sortBy` and report `order[].by` (dataset names, not object fields; as before).
- **Existence on page sorts stays advisory.** An unknown name in a related list's `sort` reaches the same door and answers 400, yet `page-field-unknown` reports it at `warning`. That is a pre-existing severity call in `validate-page-field-bindings`, and this PR leaves it unchanged. Reported to the seat; not filed here.
- **Object door not crossed.** An object write carrying both `sortable: false` on a field and a built-in `listViews.*.sort` on it is judged by `os validate`, and by the view door for view items, but not by the object publish door. `validateSortableFields` does not declare `object`, and `reference-integrity-suite.ts` records that crossing as its own adjudication (#15254's note). Reported to the seat.
- **Stale liveness row.** `liveness/page.json` `record` still says `planned`, while `ui/…/PageView.tsx` reads the binding (objectui#12931). Not changed here.
